footprint.name: Logic Footprint
footprint.tagline: X-ray of volume and market aggression.
footprint.shortDescription: Observe the true interaction between supply and demand. Detect absorptions and imbalances with maximum visual clarity cluster charts. Zero-latency performance and ready-to-trade preset templates.
footprint.longDescription: Observe the exact interaction between supply and demand within each candle. Our Footprint breaks down volume by price level to detect absorptions and imbalances in real-time. Enjoy premium-aesthetic cluster charts with maximum clarity, powered by an engine that handles high volatility without freezing your platform. Configure it in seconds with our preset templates.
paragraphs: The Interior of Price Action: Unlike traditional Japanese candlesticks that only show opens, closes, and extremes, the cluster chart (Footprint) exposes the true mechanics of the auction. By breaking down the traded volume at each specific price level, separating aggressive buy (Ask) and sell (Bid) orders, this tool allows you to see exactly where the battles for control are taking place. You will be able to identify absorption zones, order flow imbalances, and high-volume nodes, giving you the analytical edge needed to trade futures with millimeter precision.

Unprecedented Visual Clarity and Versatility: We have brought the graphical capabilities of the most prestigious Order Flow platforms directly to NinjaTrader 8. Our Footprint stands out for its exceptional visual clarity, built on the use of up to three fully configurable columns per candle. You have absolute control: customize internal volume profiles, apply heatmaps to instantly highlight high-liquidity zones, and adjust opacities and colors to your liking. This versatility allows you to filter market noise and adapt the chart exactly to your visual style.

Extreme Performance for High Volatility: The biggest bottleneck in volume analysis on NinjaTrader 8 is latency. To solve this, our Footprint has been developed with an optimized performance engine that processes the complete data feed ultra-efficiently. This ensures the indicator seamlessly handles session openings and moments of extreme volatility. Your chart and cluster readings will flow in real-time, without delays or platform freezes.

Take Action in Seconds: All this analytical and graphical power doesn't have to be difficult to implement. We have eliminated the frustration of complex configurations so you can spend your time trading. The indicator includes preloaded preset templates designed for different reading styles. Additionally, you can download and apply new presets directly from our website with a couple of clicks, achieving a professional and immediate setup.

footer.name: Logic Footer
footer.tagline: Key statistics and order flow summary per candle.
footer.shortDescription: Essential Footprint companion with 23 metrics per candle, including Delta and Volume. Features heatmaps, interactive Data Box mode, zero-latency performance, and ready-to-use presets.
footer.longDescription: Essential Footprint companion with 23 metrics per candle, including Delta and Volume. Features heatmaps, interactive Data Box mode, zero-latency performance, and ready-to-use presets.
paragraphs: The Statistical Summary of the Auction: In institutional-grade trading platforms, cluster analysis is incomplete without a precise statistical panel at the base of each candle. The Footer indicator acts as the final verdict of the battle between buyers and sellers. By mathematically summarizing the Order Flow interaction, providing the net delta, divergences, and total rotation volume, this tool converts raw microscopic data into actionable information. It is the ultimate filter to confirm exhaustion or directional aggression at the close of each bar.

Exhaustive Analysis with 23 Metrics: We have designed our Footer to be the largest and most robust companion to your Footprint chart in NinjaTrader 8. We deliver a massive analytical panel featuring around 23 metrics and complementary parameters to evaluate each candle. You will have immediate access to critical variables such as max and min delta, traded volume, sequences, and precise breakdowns of market pressure. This gives you an absolute edge by allowing you to statistically audit price behavior with unparalleled depth.

Data Box Mode and Heatmaps: Visual agility is indispensable in trading. To prevent you from constantly looking away to the bottom of the chart, we have integrated a Data Box mode that allows you to visualize this critical information directly alongside the price action. Additionally, this indicator incorporates cutting-edge graphical options, highlighting the use of heatmaps. This function dynamically colors the statistics, allowing you to identify volume spikes, delta anomalies, or liquidity extremes in fractions of a second.

Optimal Calculation and Immediate Setup: Processing up to 23 statistical data points per candle simultaneously is a computationally demanding task, but our optimized performance engine ensures your NinjaTrader 8 platform suffers no delays. Data extraction is performed smoothly, keeping your charts in strict real-time. Furthermore, you retain the practicality of our suite: thanks to the integrated presets system, you can load pre-established configurations or download templates from the web, achieving a professional workspace instantly without tedious configurations.

profile.name: Logic Profile
profile.shortDescription: Analyze the auction with advanced volume profiles. Combine Delta and TPO metrics in two columns, project key levels like the POC, and trade with zero latency using ready-to-use presets.
profile.longDescription: Analyze the auction with advanced volume profiles. Combine Delta and TPO metrics in two columns, project key levels like the POC, and trade with zero latency using ready-to-use presets.
paragraphs: The Market Auction Map: Volume Profile is the fundamental tool for understanding the true market structure through Auction Market Theory. Unlike a traditional time-based chart, this indicator organizes trading activity based on price, visually revealing where institutional volume is being built. By identifying the Point of Control (POC) and the Value Area, you get a clear X-ray of acceptance and rejection zones, allowing you to anticipate key areas of support, resistance, and price rotation with professional logic.

Dual Analysis and Graphical Versatility: We have designed a highly adaptable visual architecture that includes a dual-column structure. This feature allows for unprecedented customization: in each column, you can independently configure the type of information you want to see, choosing between pure Volume, Delta, TPO (Time Price Opportunity), or combinations of Volume and Delta simultaneously. All of this is backed by an immense arsenal of graphical options that guarantee a clean, aesthetic, and customized reading tailored to your visual demands.

Projection of Levels and Exact Metrics: Keeping track of structural zones is vital for decision-making. Therefore, our indicator includes unique and dynamic options for tracking the Value Area and POC. Puedes configurar la extensión de estas líneas importantes de varias formas: en modo Naked (hasta que el precio las ponga a prueba en el futuro), hasta el inicio del siguiente perfil, o con una proyección infinita. Además, la herramienta te proporciona un panel de métricas completo que desglosa todos los datos estadísticos del perfil, entregándote el contexto matemático preciso de la sesión.

Maximum Performance and Immediate Deployment: Calculating and rendering multiple profiles, deltas, and extended lines is usually the main cause of congestion in trading platforms. However, this indicator shares the same performance engine as the rest of our suite, ensuring zero-latency data processing and smooth navigation in NinjaTrader 8, even on the most volatile days. And to streamline your workflow, it features our integrated presets system: choose from our pre-established templates or download them from the web to have your workspace configured like a professional in a matter of clicks.

composite.name: Logic Composite
composite.tagline: Macro view of the auction and volume distribution.
composite.shortDescription: Build your custom profile anchored to the chart edges via manual drawing, prior days, or visible bars, featuring dual-column options, preset templates, and maximum performance with zero lag.
composite.longDescription: Build your custom profile anchored to the chart edges via manual drawing, prior days, or visible bars, featuring dual-column options, preset templates, and maximum performance with zero lag.
paragraphs: The Macro View of Market Structure: While session profiles show daily activity, the Composite Profile allows you to understand volume distribution at a macro level. In advanced analysis platforms, this tool is fundamental for grouping multiple days, weeks, or cycles into a single structural profile. By merging this data, the Composite reveals historical equilibrium zones, High Volume Nodes (HVN), and Low Volume Nodes (LVN) or liquidity gaps, providing you with the exact coordinates of long-term structural support and resistance areas.

Total Control with Manual Drawing and Anchoring: To offer you absolute analytical flexibility, we have equipped our Composite indicator with a manual drawing mode directly on the chart. This means you can precisely select any range of price action to build your custom profile instantly. Furthermore, the indicator cleanly anchors to the right or left side of your screen, allowing you to keep the macro context always in view without obstructing the reading of candles or real-time order flow.

Dual Analysis and Maximum Customization: The Composite inherits all the visual and analytical power of our stellar Volume Profile. You retain the dual-column architecture, allowing you to independently and simultaneously configure advanced metrics such as pure Volume, Delta, or TPO (Time Price Opportunity) within your macro panorama. Added to this, you have an extensive catalog of graphical settings that will allow you to adapt colors, opacities, and aesthetic details so that liquidity reading is extremely clean.

Massive Processing without Latency: Grouping and calculating the volume of hundreds of thousands of historical candles is the ultimate test for any platform. Our Composite is powered by the same native performance engine as the rest of the suite, guaranteeing that you can load massive analysis areas without experiencing freezes or delays in your NinjaTrader 8 environment. And so you can get straight to action, the indicator integrates with our preset templates system, ready to be applied or downloaded from the web with a single click.

bigtrades.name: Logic BigTrades
bigtrades.tagline: Precise real-time detection of institutional activity.
bigtrades.shortDescription: Track large institutional order blocks, generate support and resistance zones from their activity, and easily visualize trade sizes with an integrated histogram. Adjust filters and visuals on the fly without chart reloads and with peak performance.
bigtrades.longDescription: Track large institutional order blocks, generate support and resistance zones from their activity, and easily visualize trade sizes with an integrated histogram. Adjust filters and visuals on the fly without chart reloads and with peak performance.
paragraphs: The Trail of Aggression on the Tape: In professional trading, reading the tape (Time and Sales) is crucial, but interpreting that raw, fast data is visually exhausting. The Big Trades indicator translates this information by filtering out market noise and exclusively identifying large-volume executed orders. By revealing where massive transactions and aggressive capital injections are occurring, you can anticipate structural breaks, strong absorption zones, and directional exhaustion points with a precision that traditional candles completely hide.

Visual Innovation and Magnetic Clustering: To keep your chart clean and readable during moments of high volatility, we have developed unique visual modes. Our 'magnetic clustering' stands out—a visualization algorithm that intelligently condenses multiple large orders into high-density zones, preventing visual clutter. Additionally, it features advanced graphical characteristics like heatmaps and custom scale modes, allowing you to visually differentiate the impact and size of each transaction with absolute aesthetic clarity.

Analysis Arsenal and Level Drawing: This indicator goes far beyond drawing simple circles or bubbles on the chart. We have incorporated a data scanner to inspect each bubble in detail, an integrated volume histogram, and a sound alert system so you never miss an important liquidity injection. Added to this, the tool allows you to create level lines automatically or manually from these transactions, turning every massive aggression into an exact technical reference for the future.

Dynamic Filters and Optimal Performance: Identifying and processing high-frequency activity requires extreme efficiency. Our Big Trades is designed to be highly optimal, allowing the modification and configuration of volume filters in strict real-time without freezing NinjaTrader 8. Keep your platform fast, stable, and latency-free, and leverage our ecosystem of preset templates to load your configurations and start tracking institutional operations in a matter of seconds.

analytics.name: Logic Analytics
analytics.tagline: Deep statistical analysis by market segments.
analytics.shortDescription: Isolate and analyze market portions with statistical precision. Get volume histograms, accumulated delta, and standard deviations in configurable boxes. Optimal performance and ready-to-trade preset templates.
analytics.longDescription: Isolate and analyze market portions with statistical precision. Get volume histograms, accumulated delta, and standard deviations in configurable boxes. Optimal performance and ready-to-trade preset templates.
paragraphs: Statistical Scrutiny of the Market: In professional trading, not all phases of the session have the same relevance. The Analytics indicator allows you to isolate specific areas of price action to subject them to deep statistical scrutiny. By enclosing a set of candles within a study box, the tool instantly extracts the mathematical truth of that segment. This provides you with an absolute vision of the volume behavior and directional strength of that zone, completely eliminating the external noise of the rest of the chart.

Mathematical Metrics and Accumulated Delta: Once the area is defined, Analytics deploys an advanced data ecosystem within it. It automatically generates a volume histogram and an accumulated delta curve to evaluate the constant pressure of the auction. Furthermore, it extracts the vital data of the enclosed candles (volume, positive delta, negative delta, and time range) and applies institutional statistical rigor: it calculates the average, standard deviation, and maximum expected value (average plus deviation). All this precise data is visually reflected on the histogram for quick reading.

Dynamic Control: Automatic and Manual Mode: The versatility of this tool adapts to any trading plan. If you seek a systematic analysis of the session, the automatic mode draws the boxes on its own based on session time ranges you define, ideal for comparing opening volatility versus the close. If you prefer a tactical approach, the manual mode gives you the freedom to draw and adjust each box directly on the chart, allowing you to dissect consolidations, pullbacks, or ranging zones on your own terms.

Complex Calculations without Latency: Calculating averages, delta curves, and standard deviations instantly requires superior processing power. Analytics is backed by the same native performance engine as the rest of our suite, guaranteeing that these deep mathematical calculations are executed in real-time without generating latency or freezes in NinjaTrader 8. And to streamline your analysis workflow, it maintains compatibility with our preset templates ecosystem, allowing you to load your favorite visual and statistical configuration with a single click.

algorithms.name: Logic Algorithms
algorithms.tagline: Automated detection of microstructure and critical Order Flow events.
algorithms.shortDescription: Automatically detect absorptions, imbalances, trapped traders, and other key events. Activate multiple algorithms with a single click, enjoy zero-latency performance, and load ready-to-trade presets.
algorithms.longDescription: Automatically detect absorptions, imbalances, trapped traders, and other key events. Activate multiple algorithms with a single click, enjoy zero-latency performance, and load ready-to-trade presets.
paragraphs: Advanced Order Flow Automation: Market microstructure analysis demands identifying complex patterns in fractions of a second. The Algorithms indicator acts as your advanced analytical assistant, relentlessly scanning the order flow to find the most critical directional events. Instead of manually searching for anomalies in clusters, volume, or delta, this tool groups 11 algorithmic calculations that mechanically detect institutional footprints, delivering precise confirmations right when the execution opportunity presents itself.

The Detection Arsenal: 11 Algorithms: Your chart becomes a high-precision institutional radar. The tool integrates a set of detections that includes Imbalance zones, advanced clusters, Exhaustions, and aggressive Absorptions. It identifies critical technical levels through Unfinished Auctions, Zero Nodes, and isolated Volume Peaks. Furthermore, it locates the impact of key participants by revealing Whale Blocks (massive orders), Trapped Traders, and evaluates market pressure through Reversals and Delta Divergences.

Interactive Control and Visual Clarity: We understand that price action is dynamic and your screen should not be saturated with unnecessary signals. Therefore, we have equipped this indicator with an interactive system featuring quick-access buttons that allow you to turn the visualization of any algorithm on or off on the fly. Added to this, each of the 11 calculations has fully independent graphical options, giving you the freedom to customize visual alerts, shapes, and specific colors for each type of event.

Simultaneous Processing and Immediate Deployment: Executing 11 mathematical algorithms simultaneously on live data is a severe technical challenge for any platform. However, our optimized performance engine absorbs this massive computational load, guaranteeing that NinjaTrader 8 remains stable, fast, and latency-free, even if you decide to keep all detections turned on at the same time. And to maintain an agile workflow, the indicator includes our preset templates system, allowing you to load professional configurations in a matter of seconds.
